title: Unirational del Pezzo surfaces of degree one
summary: We construct explicit unirational del Pezzo surfaces of degree $1$ with arithmetic Picard rank one over $\mathbb{Q}$, $\mathbb{F}_5$, and $\mathbb{C}(t)$. Moreover, we prove that every smooth real geometrically rational surface is unirational over $\mathbb{R}$ if and only if it has a real point.
